project_type: React 18 SPA with TypeScript + Vite, Arabic RTL university education platform
test_framework: No test framework - no test files present. Validation is via TypeScript compilation and visual inspection.
verification_instructions: 1. Verify CSS files have valid syntax (no unclosed braces, no broken selectors). 2. Verify tokens.css is self-consistent (all referenced variables exist). 3. Verify no TypeScript compilation errors were introduced in component changes. Since node_modules are unavailable due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode, use manual CSS syntax validation.
setup_instructions: No setup possible - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode prevents npm install. node_modules are not available. All work must be CSS-only and component TSX modifications that don't add new dependencies.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no CDN fetches, no external resources. node_modules not available so TypeScript compilation and Vite build cannot run. Verification limited to manual CSS/TSX syntax validation. Fonts loaded via Google Fonts link in index.html (already configured, will work at runtime).
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality. Only modify visual layer (CSS) and component markup/classnames. Do not add new npm dependencies.
key_patterns: CSS custom properties (tokens.css) define the design system. app.css is the main comprehensive stylesheet loaded LAST (overrides all). CSS load order in main.tsx: tokens.css -> dashboard.css -> landing.css -> landing-auth-v3.css -> redesign-lecture.css -> redesign-matrix.css -> owner.css -> app.css -> pdf.css. RTL-native using logical properties (inset-inline-start, margin-inline, padding-block). color-mix() used extensively. Material Design 3-inspired token naming. Dark theme is default (:root), light theme via [data-theme='light'].
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - all CSS files (design tokens + components + page-specific). frontend/src/pages/ - page components organized by role (student/, teacher/, admin/, quality/, owner/). frontend/src/components/ - shared components (layout/ for shell, primitives/ for base UI). frontend/src/stores/ - zustand stores. frontend/src/hooks/ - custom hooks. frontend/src/lib/ - utilities.
